title: On quasi-holomorphic homotopies of immersions of 3-manifolds into 5-manifolds
summary: The notion of a quasi-holomorphic homotopy of two immersions of a $3$-manifold into a $5$-manifold extends the notion of their regular homotopy by also allowing the homotopy to pass through instances of maps with an isolated singularity around which the path of the homotopy forms a cross-cap (complex Whitney umbrella). We describe the local form of such homotopies and explain connections with the theory of holomorphic map germs from $\mathbb{C}^2$ to $\mathbb{C}^3$.
